scientific_integrity: The proof specializes classical Markov empirical-flow large deviations; the new part is the exact three-allele entropy contraction and uniqueness of conditioned flows. No independent external validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Valid only for three types, positive mutation weights, and the specified no-repeat chain.
Conditional transition concentration is stated for interior occupation vectors.
The 1976 Hsia three-state occupation paper was not fully accessible for overlap comparison.
title: Exact occupation large deviations and universal rare transitions for three-allele mutation spines
